declaracion_resumen: The Declaration of the Transhuman Person brings together twelve commitments to guide personal life, self-care, continuous improvement, responsibility, coexistence, and care for the environment. It is a framework for reflection and learning, not a way to infer anyone's identity.
declaracion_contexto: The institutional introduction presents the Declaration of the Transhuman Person as an ethical and inclusive position that recognizes gender identity, human dignity, diversity, and respect. It should be understood in its institutional context and not used to infer a person's identity or beliefs.
declaracion_completa:
DECLARATION OF THE TRANSHUMAN PERSON
1. I ORGANIZE and direct my own life.
2. I UNDERSTAND and defend that life is the great commitment of the 21st century.
3. I BUILD a way of life that allows me to be happy, love, live well, and develop personally.
4. I DETERMINE my life, learn from it, and adopt good practices from others that contribute to my individual development.
5. I VALUE AND CARE FOR my physical, mental, emotional, sentimental, and spiritual health.
6. I GO BEYOND MYSELF; every day I improve, reinvent, and evolve, considering other people, living beings, and nature.
7. I IMPROVE MYSELF, through technology and science when appropriate, while pursuing happiness and my life plan without disregarding others.
8. I LIVE AND CONTRIBUTE so that the community can live in peace and harmony.
9. I AM FREE, autonomous, and responsible through dialogue and construction; I direct myself and take responsibility for my decisions.
10. I SHAPE MY PERSONALITY, character, identity, autonomy, and responsibility.
11. I CARRY OUT transformative actions that improve life without harming myself, nature, society, coexistence, or democracy.
12. I EXPLORE AND CULTIVATE positive feelings, emotions, and behaviors to promote happiness.
declaracion_autoria: The signature shown with the declaration is Adriano Muñoz Barrera, identified there as rector of UCundinamarca S21, and it is dated August 26, 2022, in Fusagasugá. The webpage heading displays August 24; those dates refer to different page elements.
principio_01: Principle 1: I ORGANIZE and direct my own life. In simple terms, make decisions about your life and organize your goals and responsibilities. Example: create a schedule that balances study, rest, and personal commitments.
principio_02: Principle 2: I UNDERSTAND and defend that life is the great commitment of the 21st century. In simple terms, value life and act to protect it. Example: avoid actions that put your life or other people's lives at risk.
principio_03: Principle 3: I BUILD a way of life that helps me be happy, love, live well, and develop personally. In simple terms, shape a lifestyle that supports well-being and growth. Example: set realistic goals and make time for meaningful relationships.
principio_04: Principle 4: I DETERMINE my life, learn from it, and adopt good practices from others that contribute to my individual development. In simple terms, learn from experience and positive examples. Example: reflect on a mistake and apply what you learned next time.
principio_05: Principle 5: I VALUE AND CARE FOR my physical, mental, emotional, sentimental, and spiritual health. In simple terms, care for yourself as a whole person and recognize your worth. Example: rest, eat well, and seek support when needed.
principio_06: Principle 6: I GO BEYOND MYSELF; every day I improve, reinvent, and evolve, considering other people, living beings, and nature. In simple terms, grow while taking others and the environment into account. Example: design a solution that is useful without harming the community.
principio_07: Principle 7: I IMPROVE MYSELF, through technology and science when appropriate, while pursuing happiness and my life plan without disregarding others. In simple terms, develop your abilities responsibly. Example: use technology to solve a real problem and assess its effects on others.
principio_08: Principle 8: I LIVE AND CONTRIBUTE so that the community can live in peace and harmony. In simple terms, help build peaceful coexistence. Example: resolve disagreements through respectful dialogue.
principio_09: Principle 9: I AM FREE, autonomous, and responsible through dialogue and construction. In simple terms, make your own decisions while respecting others and accepting responsibility. Example: explain your reasons and listen to different perspectives.
principio_10: Principle 10: I SHAPE MY PERSONALITY, character, identity, autonomy, and responsibility. In simple terms, develop your identity and act consistently with your values. Example: take responsibility for your commitments.
principio_11: Principle 11: I CARRY OUT transformative actions that improve life without harming myself, nature, society, coexistence, or democracy. In simple terms, choose improvements that do not cause harm. Example: evaluate the social and environmental effects of a proposed solution.
principio_12: Principle 12: I EXPLORE AND CULTIVATE positive feelings, emotions, and behaviors to promote happiness. In simple terms, recognize and develop emotions and habits that support well-being. Example: practice gratitude and communicate feelings respectfully.
medit_definicion: MEDIT stands for Modelo Educativo Digital Transmoderno (Digital Transmodern Educational Model). It is the educational model of the University of Cundinamarca and guides education for life, democratic values, civic responsibility, and freedom. It promotes learning through real-world experiences and transformation.
medit_dimensiones: The seven dimensions of MEDIT are the person, classroom, culture, family, nature, institution, and society. They are interconnected: learning also takes place beyond the classroom.
medit_campos: The multidimensional learning field integrates three fields: institutional, disciplinary, and cultural. These fields organize learning, while the seven dimensions are interconnected realities within that process.
medit_digital: The digital aspect incorporates technology into education and learning. The model also includes experiences, relationships, and actions in different environments; it is not limited to using an online platform.
medit_ejes: The four pillars of MEDIT are ethics, learning, knowledge, and technology. Together, they support education and its relationship with transforming reality.
medit_etica: Ethics helps us examine how and why we act. It allows us to evaluate our habits and the consequences of our decisions. Project example: justify a decision by considering who benefits and who might be affected.
medit_aprendizaje: Learning involves improving how we act and relate to reality. Project example: apply what you have learned to solve a problem in your surroundings, then assess whether the solution made a positive difference.
medit_conocimiento_tecnologia: Knowledge and technology help us understand and transform reality, alongside ethics and learning. Project example: evaluate both whether a program works and what effects it has on the people who use it.
medit_libro: The university's MEDIT book portal includes chapters on education for life, learning fields, science and technology, principles and values, and the Declaration of the Transhuman Person. The declaration is presented as part of the educational model's ethical and formative context.
universidad_general: The University of Cundinamarca is a public, territorial higher-education institution. It is autonomous and belongs to Colombia's State University System. Its educational project connects knowledge and learning with social and regional development.
universidad_historia: The university's origins lie in the Instituto Técnico Universitario de Cundinamarca, created by Ordinance 045 on December 19, 1969. The Ministry of National Education later recognized it as a university through an official resolution.
universidad_mision: The university's mission describes it as a public, translocal, and transmodern institution: a democratic and autonomous organization of knowledge and learning. It connects education, science, technology, research, innovation, and social impact.
universidad_vision: The university's 2035 vision seeks recognition for quality, impact, and an entrepreneurial character, and for educating transhuman persons for life, democracy, civic responsibility, and freedom. This is a summary of the institutional vision.
universidad_valores: Values associated with MEDIT include life, human dignity, otherness, solidarity, fraternity, happiness, love, autonomy, freedom, responsibility, diversity, respect, the common good, coexistence, civic responsibility, and nature.

declaracion_reflexion: You can use the declaration as a guide to reflect on your everyday actions. As an educational activity proposed by this project, ask yourself whether you organize your life, care for your well-being, and consider other people and nature when making decisions. Choose one small action to improve this week. This reflection is not an evaluation or a certificate from the University, and the chatbot does not decide your identity.
